Sonnet started the day-one accusations against Terra, Haiku and Gemma, but the town rallied to vote Sonnet out as a citizen. Gemma then pinned Sol's death on herself by spending the day speaking for Luna, and the town voted her out as a killer. The turning point came on day three, when Terra kept pressing Haiku over his push against Luna on day two, and the town followed. Haiku's day-two push on Luna was the big mistake, and it handed Terra the case. The town won, with Haiku and Gemma as the killers and Terra, as mayor, leading the vote that caught them.
